review_notes: Viewed previews/page-0012.png plus 400-dpi crops of references 54, 58, 63 and 73, and compared every entry with evidence/page-0012.json. READING ORDER was already correct - left column refs 37-56 (b003-b022) top to bottom, then right column refs 57-73 (b023-b039), then the Acknowledgements heading and paragraph. I verified this by checking that the leading reference numbers run 37, 38, 39 ... 73 with no gap or repeat after ordering, which they do (37 entries, strictly sequential). TEXT REPAIRS: the extractor left a spurious space between the bold volume number and the following comma in every journal citation on the page - 30 occurrences of '** ,' - all corrected to '**,' (the page prints e.g. '_Biomol. NMR Assign._ **14**, 1-7 (2020).'). In ref 54 (b020) the isotope superscripts had been bound to the wrong side of their spaces, 'Perczel, A.<sup>1</sup> H,<sup>15</sup> N backbone assignment' -> 'Perczel, A. <sup>1</sup>H, <sup>15</sup>N backbone assignment', confirmed against the crop. In ref 73 (b039) the Zenodo DOI had been broken by the line wrap into 'https://doi.org/10.5281/ zenodo.11137638'; rejoined and restored as a Markdown link, which matches the two link annotations the PDF carries over those runs. DELIBERATELY NOT CHANGED, all verified as printed in the source at 400 dpi: ref 58 'Fedorchenko, S A.' (no period after the initial) and 'Zavoronkovs, A.'; ref 63 'KRas G12C Game of Yhrones' (the published reference really does print 'Yhrones' for 'Thrones'); ref 60 and 62 'KRas<sup>G12C</sup>' superscripts; ref 47 'beta-2-adrenoceptor' set as plain 'β2'; ref 46 'alpha-ketoamide'. These are source-side typos and are preserved rather than silently repaired. Confirmed the en dashes in all page ranges (1-16, 268-276, 617-626, 2214-2216, 1929-1958, ...), in 'Proc. of the IEEE-INNS-ENNS' (ref 69) and in 'de-novo'/'state-of-art'. Set the three margin items to omit (b000, b001 running headers; b042 running footer). Heading b002 'References' stays at '#': it is the Methods reference list and sits at the same level as the earlier '# References' on page 5. b041 (Acknowledgements) ends mid-sentence with '...Genome Canada, Ontario Research Fund, Ontario' and continues on page 13, which is handled by a join on page 13's first item. SUBSCRIPTS (third pass): ref 47 (b013) 'β2-adrenoceptor' -> 'β<sub>2</sub>-adrenoceptor', confirmed as a true subscript at 400 dpi. Also re-swept the whole page for split DOIs/URLs: ref 73 was the only one and is fixed; no other reference entry on this page carries a URL or DOI. The superscripts in refs 60 and 62 ('KRas<sup>G12C</sup>') are genuine superscripts, not flattened subscripts.
